Reactants are chlorine gas and sodium metal.
Chlorine gas is an oxidizing agent and sodium metal is an alkali metal.
The reaction between chlorine gas and sodium metal produces sodium hypochlorite and hydrogen gas.
The reaction is: 2Na + Cl2 -> Na2OCl + Cl2 (This is a simplification, the actual reaction is more complex involving water or other species depending on conditions, but the primary product involving the elements is sodium hypochlorite and chlorine).
The most common reaction in aqueous solution is 2Na + Cl2 -> Na2OCl.
